description: Pure parse-level acceptance/rejection of the path surface: the ! sheet-separator alias rule (§3.1) and the bracket-then-caret rule (§3.3). These are profile-agnostic syntax facts within treecalc-v1; profile gating itself lives in profiles/gating.json.

cases.name: ! accepted at the sheet position
cases.note: ! is accepted as a separator alias only immediately after the first identifier (the sheet position).

expect.reason: ! is allowed only at the first separator position (after the first identifier), not mid-path
leading ! has no first identifier to follow

cases.name: ^ after a bracket selector is rejected

expect.reason: a bracket prefix is absolute from the selected workspace root; the up-step ^ is meaningless after it

cases.name: leading [#Name] is not a meta-accessor form

expect.reason: standalone meta accessors use @NAME; # special items are accepted only in a structured-reference/table tail such as Table[#Headers]
